name: miaflor Familien- & Aktivresort
beschreibung: The miaflor Familien- & Aktivresort is located in Ried im Oberinntal in Tirol. The accommodation is geared toward the needs of families and active vacationers. The surrounding area is ideal for hiking in summer and skiing in winter. The resort has several pools, a wellness area, and childcare offerings. The facilities are modern. The catering consists of breakfast and dinner, using regional products. The hotel serves as a starting point for excursions to nearby ski areas and nature parks in the region.
